assessment.verifiedEvidence: Checked the official question and official answer (ロ) at https://www.shiken.or.jp/construction/upload/20240526_co_second_q01.pdf and _a01.pdf. Checked https://www.meti.go.jp/policy/safety_security/industrial_safety/sangyo/electric/files/20231226-2.pdf (SHA256 7ff56485…, PDF p.145-146). Interpretation Art. 146(2)(i), Table 146-1: annealed copper wire with a diameter of at least 2.0 mm and less than 2.6 mm is rated at 35 A. Table 146-3: the correction factor for vinyl compounds is √((60−θ)/30), and θ is taken as 30 at 30℃ or below, so the factor is 1.0. Table 146-4: 4 wires in one conduit gives 0.63. 35×1.0×0.63 = 22.05, which gives 22 A. Distractor イ matches 1.6 mm wire (27 A) × 0.63 = 17.01.

explanationIssues: The citation '第148条第二号・第五号' leaves out the paragraph number. Article 148 also has a paragraph 2, so the citation is ambiguous. Correct it to '第148条第1項第二号・第五号（イ・ロ）'.
assessment.verifiedEvidence: Checked the official question and the official answer (ハ) against the question figure: 電熱器 10 A, 電動機 20 A×2, and vertical lines inside the B symbols on the two motor branches. The public crop q9.png matches the original figure. Checked https://www.meti.go.jp/policy/safety_security/industrial_safety/sangyo/electric/files/20231226-2.pdf, PDF p.147. Art. 148(1)(ii)(イ): motor total 40 A is greater than the other loads (10 A) and is 50 A or less, so I_W = 1.25×40+10 = 60 A. Art. 148(1)(v)(イ): 3×40+10 = 130 A. Art. 148(1)(v)(ロ): the cap is 2.5×60 = 150 A. 130 A does not exceed 150 A, so I_B = 130 A.

explanationIssues: The sentence '配線用遮断器からコンセントまでの8mは、この表で定める電線の最小太さとコンセント定格の判定を変えない。' appears twice in a row at the end of the explanation. Delete one of them.
assessment.verifiedEvidence: Checked the official question and the official answer (イ) against the four original option figures (B 20A/30A, 2.0/2.0/1.6/2.6 mm) and the outlet rating text under each figure. The public crops q10-i/ro/ha/ni.png each match their original figure. Checked https://www.meti.go.jp/policy/safety_security/industrial_safety/sangyo/electric/files/20231226-2.pdf, PDF p.148-149. Art. 149(1)(i): the breaker is placed within 3 m of the branch point. Table 149-1: a 20 A breaker needs at least 1.6 mm wire, and a 30 A breaker needs at least 2.6 mm wire. Table 149-3: a 20 A breaker takes outlets of 20 A or less. A 30 A breaker takes outlets of at least 20 A and at most 30 A.
